name: Project X-Nexus Executor
changelog: V1.6.0: Custom FPS cap input for whole numbers from 30 to 1000, with existing backup and running-game safeguards. New read-only Quick check for Roblox state, saved FPS, restore-point validity and local Xeno/Solara detection. Diagnostics never launch executors or change settings. Home executor controls and standalone FPS mode retained.
